summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI research, applications, and ethics. OpenAI's acquisition of NextSlide and pause on Astra model development due to security concerns are notable. Meanwhile, DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves a breakthrough in forecasting cyclones, and Anthropic designs its own hardware to power Claude.
insight: The increasing focus on AI safety and security is a common thread across many of this week's stories, from OpenAI's pause on Astra to Anthropic's efforts to design its own hardware, highlighting the industry's growing recognition of the need for responsible AI development.
highlights: OpenAI acquires NextSlide and pauses Astra model development due to security concerns
DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves a breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
Anthropic designs its own hardware to power Claude, reducing dependence on Nvidia
